WITH `ru_cn` AS (
    SELECT `cn`.`id`
    FROM `company_name` AS `cn`
    WHERE `cn`.`country_code` = '[ru]'
),
`rt_actor` AS (
    SELECT `rt`.`id`
    FROM `role_type` AS `rt`
    WHERE `rt`.`role` = 'actor'
),
`ru_mc` AS (
    SELECT `mc`.`movie_id`
    FROM `movie_companies` AS `mc`
    JOIN `ru_cn` AS `cn` ON `cn`.`id` = `mc`.`company_id`
    JOIN `company_type` AS `ct` ON `ct`.`id` = `mc`.`company_type_id`
),
`voice_ci` AS (
    SELECT `ci`.`movie_id`, `ci`.`person_role_id`
    FROM `cast_info` AS `ci`
    JOIN `rt_actor` AS `rt` ON `rt`.`id` = `ci`.`role_id`
    WHERE `ci`.`note` LIKE '%(voice)%'
      AND `ci`.`note` LIKE '%(uncredited)%'
),
`recent_title` AS (
    SELECT `id`, `title`
    FROM `title`
    WHERE `production_year` > 2005
),
`matched` AS (
    SELECT `t`.`id`, `t`.`title`, `ci`.`person_role_id`
    FROM `recent_title` AS `t`
    JOIN `ru_mc` AS `mc` ON `mc`.`movie_id` = `t`.`id`
    JOIN `voice_ci` AS `ci` ON `ci`.`movie_id` = `mc`.`movie_id`
                           AND `ci`.`movie_id` = `t`.`id`
)
SELECT MIN(`chn`.`name`) AS `uncredited_voiced_character`,
       MIN(`m`.`title`) AS `russian_movie`
FROM `matched` AS `m`
JOIN `char_name` AS `chn` ON `chn`.`id` = `m`.`person_role_id`
